figurative_meaning_bn: আকাশই যার সীমা; আসলে যার কোন সীমা পরিসীমা নেই
figurative_meaning_en: Whose limit is the sky; in reality, it has no boundaries or limits
example_sentences_in_english: The potential of this project is sky-high.
note: Often used to describe boundless human desires or goals in everyday Bengali speech.
